name: GCheck
tagline: A buyer-focused look at GCheck for teams comparing governance, risk, & compliance options
summary: GCheck is an FCRA-compliant background screening platform for mid-market HR teams and staffing agencies. Services include criminal, MVR, employment, education, and drug screening, backed by SOC 2 Type 2 controls and integrations with Workday, UKG, ADP, Greenhouse, and 50+ other ATS/HRIS systems. Strongest in Healthcare, Manufacturing, Transportation, and Construction, where compliance and MVR coverage drive buying decisions.
